title.zh: 所得税（经济发展与技术开发贷款利息及其他付款豁免）公告 2006
title.en: Income Tax (Exemption of Interest and Other Payments for Economic and Technological Development Loans) Notification 2006

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Income Tax (Exemption of Interest and Other Payments for Economic and Technological Development Loans) Notification 2006.

2.—(1) There shall be exempt from tax the interest payable by Herning Shipping Asia Pte Ltd from 26th April 2005 to 30th June 2019 (both dates inclusive) to Herning Shipping a.s. under the Loan Agreement dated 9th June 2005 in respect of the vessel “Pacific Venturer” (re-named “Sara Theresa”).
(2) The exemption is subject to conditions specified in the letter of approval dated 27th December 2005 addressed to Herning Shipping Asia Pte Ltd.
